reason: I'll follow the escaping disk material toward the neighbouring cloud, starting at its source.
expectation: The disk gas and dust will leave or move away from the young star, though its route to the cloud is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The outer cloud also relates to a goal, but I'd like to follow the disk material first.

effect: The escaping flow carries fine grains back toward the nursery, so I can follow it into the neighbouring cloud.
reaction: It's interesting that the radiation removes gas and fine dust while leaving compact worlds behind.
reason: Combine the escaping material with the neighbouring cloud to follow its destination.
expectation: The escaping gas and dust will join or interact with the cold cloud.

effect: The disk outflow joined the cold cloud, completing that goal; I can now follow the material entering the tail.
reaction: The mixture of matter with different histories is a satisfying connection.
reason: Combine the outer cloud with gas flowing along the tail to follow its gathering beyond the spiral.
expectation: The cloud and tail gas will gather or interact in the growing tail.

alternatives.reason: The pillars also relate to the remaining goal, but I'll follow the outer cloud first.

effect: The outer cloud and cold inflow now form a reservoir near the tail's base; the pillars remain to be followed.
reaction: The reservoir connects the earlier drawn-out cloud to the growing tail.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it follows the surviving nursery pillars.
expectation: The nursery outflow will interact with the dense pillars, perhaps carrying or reshaping them toward the tail.

effect: The outflow carried surviving dense clumps toward the tail, where they can meet the gathered gas.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the pillars' surviving material continue its journey.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it brings the clumps into the tail reservoir.
expectation: The clumps will join the tail gas and perhaps gather further beyond the spiral.

effect: The surviving clumps joined the tail gas and helped form a star cluster, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see material cleared from one nursery contribute to another gathering.

mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the nursery clumps into the tail reservoir was most worthwhile: it connected their earlier journey to the birth of a new cluster.

leastWorthwhile.text: Gathering the tail reservoir felt mostly preparatory on its own, though it set up the ending.

surprise.text: I was interested that escaping disk material could join a cold cloud containing matter that had never entered the disk.

arbitrary.text: The purpose of each action was reasonably clear; the final two combinations were also the only gameplay options offered, rather than discoveries of compatibility.

continue.text: Yes. Following material between distinct environments and seeing its earlier history matter made me curious about what happens next.
